meta.description: Symbolic proof scaffold for Pi_A idempotence under stable admissibility.

proof_scaffold.target_statement: Pi_A(Pi_A(x)) ~ Pi_A(x) under stable admissibility conditions SA-001 through SA-005.

conditions.statement: The admissibility window A is non-empty.
Pi_A maps every candidate in its declared domain into A.
For y in A, Pi_A(y) is equivalent to y under the declared admissibility equivalence relation.
Residue and orientation constraints remain stable between first and second application.
No boundary drift changes A between Pi_A(x) and Pi_A(Pi_A(x)).

symbolic_steps.description: Apply first projection. By SA-002, y is in A.
Apply second projection to result of first.
Since y is in A, apply SA-003 fixed point property.
Substitution of y and z confirms idempotence under SA conditions.
